title: Quietly Romantic Venezuelan Chicken Paella
description: A low calorie, wine infused Venezuelan dish featuring golden syrup and mirepoix base, perfect for a romantic evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium high heat.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the white wine, golden syrup, saffron threads, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the uncooked white rice to the pan, stirring to combine with the chicken and sauce.
Cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
